'''Coruscant power generator engineers''' were in charge of the [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|Coruscant power generators]].

==History==
Many [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|bombing]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in which their generator was destroyed by several [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid|demolition droids]], eliminating power to most of Coruscant and allowing the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] to spread fear to continue the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The engineers were taken severely by surprise. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that ambushed them where disguised as sweeper droids and swiftly killed engineers outside, taking the ones inside the generator center by surprise. [[Unidentified Coruscant power generator engineer|One engineer]] hid behind a computer console and found a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. He then got up and shot one of the droids, who resisted the shot and killed the engineer.
